keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Equi Fernández (Bayer 04 Leverkusen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Augsburg 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Christian Kofane (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Edmond Tapsoba with a through ball.
Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Augsburg 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1.
Goal! Augsburg 1, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Hennes Behrens with a through ball.
Goal! Augsburg 2, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Fabian Rieder with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Augsburg. Alexis Claude-Maurice replaces Arijon Ibrahimovic.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Patrik Schick replaces Christian Kofane.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Guéla Doué replaces Jarell Quansah.
Delay in match (Bayer 04 Leverkusen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
